description.p: Flo turns your voice into clean text in any app. Hold a key, speak in English, Hindi or Hinglish, and Flo types it where your cursor is.

ul.li: Speech to text runs on your own computer and works offline
Meeting notes with who said what, a summary and action items
To-dos from your screen, Slack and Gmail, as selective as you choose
An assistant and an agent in a small pill you can drag anywhere

description.p: One Flo at a time: Google sign-in no longer opens a second copy. The pill appears after you sign in.
